description: Report credential setup and client diagnostics: installed build identity, the API minimum version, and current/outdated/unknown compatibility. Current means meeting the minimum, not the newest release. Missing or unreachable health reports unknown. latest/updateAvailable say whether a newer RightSide CLI/MCP is published (null when unknown); when true, follow suggestedFix (`rightside self-update`, or `npm install -g @rightsidehost/cli@latest` for npm installs, then restart the MCP client). The token itself is never returned.
name: login_status
